chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام.
Concerning a woman who deflowered a slave-girl with her hand,
he عليه السلام said: “Upon her is her dower, and she is to be lashed eighty times.”

key_terms.اقْتَضَّتْ: deflowered; caused the loss of virginity
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman; the female perpetrator mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.بِيَدِهَا: with her hand; indicating the manner of the act
key_terms.تُجْلَدُ: she is lashed; the prescribed corporal punishment
key_terms.جَارِيَةً: a slave-girl; the female victim in the case
key_terms.مَهْرُهَا: her dower; the financial compensation due

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman manually deflowers a slave-girl according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who caused the loss of a slave-girl’s virginity by hand. It establishes financial liability through payment of the dower and also prescribes a corporal punishment of eighty lashes.
